testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.data.datasource.postgres.PostgresWritableIntegrationTests

testcase.name: INSERT writes a real row with typed values, reports one affected row and returns the generated key()
a wrong password is AUTH_REJECTED, definite, and neither the password nor the user appears anywhere()
UPDATE changes exactly the supplied columns of exactly the keyed row()
deleting a row that another table still references is refused and nothing is removed()
no connection stays open after a mutation, a failure or a timeout()
unique, not-null, check and foreign-key violations are MUTATION_REJECTED with a fixed message, nothing applied, and the key may be released()
a statement that runs past the time limit is TIMEOUT, is stopped by the server, and the outcome is treated as unknown()
a connection killed while the statement runs is an AMBIGUOUS outcome - CONNECT_FAILED, not definite, never retryable, and nothing was committed()
UPDATE and DELETE of a key that matches nothing succeed with zero affected rows()
a data source that is not writable, a schema that is not configured and a statement without a key are refused and change nothing()
INSERT without RETURNING reports the row count and no output()
a superuser is refused before the statement is sent()
an incomplete credential is INVALID_CREDENTIAL before any connection()
hostile values are stored as data and never executed()
a change that would touch more rows than maxAffectedRows is rolled back and refused()
the connection test of a writable source uses a read-write session and reports the role's ability to write()
a constraint violation on UPDATE leaves the row as it was()
the same mutation run twice is NOT idempotent at the connector - that is the gateway's job, and a unique key makes the replay a definite rejection()
a failing mutation logs no value, no SQL and no credential()
a value that does not fit the column is INVALID_PARAMS and nothing is applied()
a role without write privilege gets PERMISSION_DENIED and nothing is written()
an unreachable database is CONNECT_FAILED and carries no address or credential()
DELETE removes exactly the keyed row once()
